name: 13278-imagechat-qwen25vl72b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct -- bf16, no quantization, 145 GB of safetensors.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8, pp1, dp1, ep1 -- one node, one engine. The rank count is part of the declaration and must not be changed.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16: an 80-layer Qwen2.5 language model (hidden 8192, 64 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, vocab 152064, context 128k, mrope) behind a 32-layer ViT (hidden 1280, patch 14, 2x2 spatial merge, out_hidden_size 8192). ~18.1 GB of weights per rank at TP8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=96 against 64 admitted, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% (both mode=requests), bounded at 1024 requests with a 1200 s safety cap. 96 is part of the declaration: a lower concurrency measures a different regime and is not comparable.
workload: guidellm over the OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint, one turn per request: one 1120x700 random-noise JPEG plus 400-500 tokens of text in, 80-100 tokens out, both lengths uniform over their range, decoded at temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos so the output length is not itself a variable.
purpose: A 72-billion-parameter vision assistant captioning one photo plus a short prompt, ninety-six concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# The sglang launch flags. Flat `key: value` only -- an indented line is skipped, so a nested
# block is DROPPED and the engine starts without whatever it declared.
# `fa3` on both backends needs `sgl_kernel.flash_attn` importable in the venv, and SM90.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct
tp-size: 8
trust-remote-code: true
max-running-requests: 64
mem-fraction-static: 0.65
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
attention-backend: fa3
mm-attention-backend: fa3
chat-template: qwen2-vl
enable-cache-report: true
random-seed: 42
